summary: DRDGOLD Limited, a South African gold producer, filed a Form 6-K containing a trading statement for the year ended 30 June 2026. The statement reports expected EPS and HEPS increases of 85-95% versus the prior year, driven by a 40% rise in the rand gold price and a 1% increase in gold sold. Revenue rose 42% to R11,159 million, while cash operating costs increased 8%. This is a routine earnings guidance update, not a special situation. No M&A, restructuring, or capital-return activity is mentioned. Watch for the full financial results release, but no risk-arb angle applies.
